purpose: Review official Turkish cadastral channels and qualify bounded anonymous parcel geometry evidence for Batman.
assessment: The official TKGM Parsel Sorgu documentation and viewer were identified. An anonymous GET to the current public coordinate API using the exact unchanged WUP point returned one polygon Feature for Batman/Merkez/Bahçelievler, ada 2851, parsel 4. This is local evidence of public parcel coverage, not a citywide completeness claim.
registryAssessment: Local cadastral custody is evidenced through the returned official TKGM feature identifying Batman/Merkez/Bahçelievler and cadastral identifiers. The service operator is the national Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Müdürlüğü; no separate Batman municipal registry endpoint was identified or needed for this bounded result.

attempts: Fetched the official TKGM Parsel Sorgulama documentation anonymously (HTTP 200).

Sent one anonymous TLS-verified GET to the documented public TKGM CBS coordinate route with the exact WUP point [37.8895886235356, 41.1305601682502], including only ordinary Origin/Referer headers; response was HTTP 200.
Observed response schema: GeoJSON-like Feature, Polygon geometry, safe cadastral IDs/names and parcel attributes; no explicit CRS member.
Retained one unchanged native polygon in batman-parcel-samples.geojson; no owner/address/contact/titleholder/tax/account/personal fields were requested or retained.
Safe field allowlist: feature geometry, ilId, ilceId, mahalleId, province/district/neighborhood names, adaNo, parselNo, pafta, and a composite safeParcelKey.
No citywide or countrywide completeness claim; runtime remains held for serial review.
